Frequency once per day. Requirements You are conscious, have at least 2 HP, and wield a gunblade. Reduce your current HP to 1; this loss cannot be prevented, redirected, or reduced and does not trigger damage-based abilities. Until the start of your next turn, gain resistance to all damage equal to twice your level. This does not prevent conditions, death effects, or damage exceeding the resistance. Normal dying rules apply if you are reduced to 0 HP. Apply Superbolide.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-effects.Item.d00ba9863847115e]{Superbolide}. Apply manually after recording the action.
